The hypothesis accurately represents these findings.
premises: AlNbTiZr MEA coatings with ~10 at.% Al form a denser oxide scale than other compositions
The oxide scale on the optimal coating consists primarily of Nb2Zr6O17 and ZrO2
The ~10 at.% Al coating yields the lowest oxygen penetration depth and thinnest oxide scale
